Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lands between thirty and sixty, a middle range that stays useful for many future items. This steers away from both near-full bins and nearly empty ones, but the band limits are a guess and may rarely match real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
